1879073713.name: On Your Feet!
1879073713.desc: You bellow a harsh command, enabling up to three defeated allies to rise, albeit at very low health.

1879090225.name: Smash
1879090225.desc: Hit small things twice. Sometimes, make things hit back slow.

1879090865.name: Piercing Trap
1879090865.desc: Places a snare to slow the enemy and cause damage over time.\n\nTrap remains for 60 seconds after being placed.

1879110961.name: Furious Claws
1879110961.desc: Your companion cuts through multiple foes with razor-sharp claws, leaving them bleeding.

1879139377.name: Bracing Victory
1879139377.desc: Draw upon reserves of strength and renew your morale.

1879145777.name: Improved Blade of Elendil
1879145777.desc:
Requires Battle-hardened State.

Deal an attack that does Light damage with an increased Crit chance.

Fellows within range gain the Light of Elendil, enabling them to deal additional Light damage.

This attack never misses and cannot be blocked, parried or evaded.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879176369.name: Remorseless Strike
1879176369.desc:
Uses fervour to deal a devastating attack.

This attack is hard to defend.

Critical hits deal massive damage. 
 
 Critical hits will reset Emboldened Blades.

1879215025.name: Poor Map to Tol Ascarnen
1879215025.desc: A poorly drawn and undetailed map to Tol Ascarnen.

1879241649.name: Hammer of Rohan
1879241649.desc: When called to action, the people of Rohan can smite their enemies with fierce cruelty and unnrelenting wrath.

1879243697.name: Shield Bash
1879243697.desc: You bash the enemy in the face with your shield, disorienting them for a few moments. A critical hit refreshes your shield-arm, allowing you to bash someone in the face again.

1879244849.name: Assault of the Eorlingas
1879244849.desc: A violent strike against the target that focuses on your offensive capability, dealing damage and increasing threat against the target.\n\n<rgb=#66ffff>Applies the Lance effect to you. Skill of the Eorlingas becomes Lancer's Charge.</rgb>

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879266865.name: Destabilizing Strike
1879266865.desc: You call upon your inner reserve of strength to unnerve your opposition, forcing them to behave as you desire on the field of battle.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Fervour</rgb>

1879269681.name: Trickster: Counter Defence
1879269681.desc: Strike to lower the enemy's defences.\n\nLimit: Trickster will allow this trick to stack.

1879270577.name: Return to Lalia's Market
1879270577.desc: This enables you to quickly return to Lalia's Market in Bree-town. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879297073.name: Volcanic Rune-stone
1879297073.desc: Places a Rune-stone upon the ground that deals damage-over-time to nearby enemies. This skill can be placed at range.\n\nThe Rune-stone will persist for 11s.

1879343921.name: Trout Kite
1879343921.desc: Brings out a trout kite for you to fly in the wind.

1879344561.name: Midnight Dragon Kite
1879344561.desc: Brings out a midnight dragon kite for you to fly!

1879360817.name: Agarnaith Wormling
1879360817.desc: Brings out an Agarnaith wormling to keep you company.

1879381553.name: Harbinger of Autumn Night
1879381553.desc: A pony from the Fall Festival.

1879411761.name: Feed-laden Donkey
1879411761.desc: Summons a loveable and hard-working donkey.

1879420849.name: Delving Nether-hound
1879420849.desc: Summons a nether-hound to help you search caverns and other tight spaces.

1879440177.name: Little Deep Toad
1879440177.desc: Summons a small deep toad to keep you company.

1879457073.name: Dashing Feline
1879457073.desc: Summons a dashing fluffy cat to accompany you on your journeys.

1879469361.name: Return to Lyndelby
1879469361.desc: Return home to Lyndelby in Misthallow. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879486001.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Umbari Guardsman)
1879486001.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879491505.name: Sail to Iridír
1879491505.desc: Navigate to Iridír in Ambarûl in the Ikorbân Valley with nearby fellows.

1879531313.name: Hound of Promised Allies
1879531313.desc: Summons a hound to faithfully follow you on your adventures.
